purpose: Candidate SEP-24 anchors evaluated for Axiom Stellar Payments Rail

candidates.name: MoneyGram (Stellar Access)
candidates.notes: MoneyGram's dedicated Stellar anchor via their 'MoneyGram Access' program. Largest remittance network on Stellar. USDC issuer matches Circle's mainnet issuer exactly. Highest institutional credibility.

candidates.name: SDF Test Anchor
candidates.notes: Official Stellar Development Foundation test anchor. Runs on Stellar testnet (not mainnet). Perfect for integration testing without real funds. Not suitable for production.

candidates.name: Anclap
candidates.notes: Established LATAM Stellar anchor. SEP-6 and SEP-24 both present. No USD payout corridor — focused on South American local currencies.

candidates.name: MyKobo
candidates.notes: European Stellar anchor specializing in EURC (Euro stablecoin). SEP-24 and SEP-6 present. Not suitable for USD corridor. Cold-start latency observed.

candidates.name: Ultra Stellar
corridors: Unknown — no currency metadata in toml
candidates.notes: SEP-24 and WEB_AUTH present at ultracapital.xyz subdomain. Transfer server on different domain than home domain. Asset list not publicly disclosed in toml.

candidates.name: Bitso
candidates.notes: VALIDATION FAILED — bitso.com stellar.toml returns 302 redirect and does not expose TRANSFER_SERVER_SEP0024 or WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT at base domain. Likely requires direct API partnership to access Stellar endpoints.

candidates.name: Tempo
candidates.notes: VALIDATION FAILED — tempo.eu.com stellar.toml is unreachable (connection timeout). Domain may have changed or service discontinued.

candidates.name: Cowrie Exchange
candidates.notes: PARTIALLY VALID — WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT present but no TRANSFER_SERVER_SEP0024. Has SEP-10 auth but does not support interactive SEP-24 withdrawal flow.

candidates.name: Stronghold
candidates.notes: VALIDATION FAILED — stronghold.co stellar.toml has no TRANSFER_SERVER_SEP0024 or WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT. Stronghold no longer operates a public Stellar SEP-24 anchor.

candidates.name: Centre Consortium (Circle USDC issuer)
corridors: USDC issuance only — no SEP-24 withdrawal
candidates.notes: INVALID for SEP-24 — centre.io stellar.toml has no TRANSFER_SERVER_SEP0024 or WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT. Circle is the USDC issuer, not a SEP-24 interactive anchor. This was the original incorrect assumption in v1 of the adapter.
